Game Overview

Guard The Baby is a casual title where dive into a thrilling challenge as a brave young boy, juggling a fruity feast and relentless animal attacks. Hone your reflexes and decision-making in this dynamic adventure where balance is key. Gobble fruits, fend off foes, and aim for record-breaking scores in a fun, fast-paced frenzy.
